newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran catches sturgeon with caviar worth $107,000.
newsitem.headline: Iran catches sturgeon with caviar worth $107,000.

text.p: Iranian fishermen have caught a 500 kg (1,102 pound) sturgeon with 54 kg (190 pounds) of high quality caviar worth 320 million riyals ($107,000), the official news agency IRNA said on Tuesday.
The 4.14-meter long fish was caught this week off the east coast of the Caspian sea, it added.
Iranian exports of caviar earned the Islamic republic about $40 million in the year ending March 1996 despite a drop in world prices.
